ext.description: Claude Code token usage & cost in VSCode status bar
config.title: Claude Status
config.displayMode.desc: Status bar display mode: utilization percentage or USD cost.
config.statusBar.alignment.desc: Position of the status bar item.
config.statusBar.showProjectCost.desc: Show current project cost in the status bar.
config.cache.ttlSeconds.desc: Cache TTL in seconds. API is not called more often than this when Claude Code is idle.
config.rateLimitApi.enabled.desc: Enable fetching rate-limit utilization (5h/7d %) from the Anthropic API. When disabled, only local token cost is shown (no rate-limit percentages). Default: true — API consumption is negligible because calls are made only when Claude Code is actively running.
config.realtime.enabled.desc: Poll the rate-limit API every cache.ttlSeconds regardless of Claude Code activity. Requires rateLimitApi.enabled to be true. Increases API usage.
config.budget.dailyUsd.desc: Daily budget in USD. Set to null to disable.
config.budget.weeklyUsd.desc: Weekly budget in USD. Set to null to disable.
config.budget.alertThresholdPercent.desc: Show budget warning when usage exceeds this percentage of the budget.
config.notifications.rateLimitWarning.de: Show notification when rate limit is approaching.
config.notifications.rateLimit5hStartPer: Start notifying once the 5h rate limit is at least this percent used.
config.notifications.rateLimit5hStepPerc: After the 5h start threshold, notify on each step of this many percent (e.g. 90, 92, 94…).
config.notifications.rateLimit7dStartPer: Start notifying once the 7d (weekly) rate limit is at least this percent used.
config.notifications.rateLimit7dEndPerce: Stop adding new 7d notifications above this percent (the cap).
config.notifications.rateLimit7dStepPerc: Between the 7d start and end thresholds, notify on each step of this many percent (e.g. 80, 85, 90).
config.notifications.budgetWarning.desc: Show notification when budget threshold is exceeded.
config.heatmap.days.desc: Number of days shown in the usage heatmap.
config.credentials.path.desc: Custom path to Claude credentials file. Leave null to use default (~/.claude/.credentials.json).
config.claudeProvider.desc: Claude provider type. Controls whether rate limit percentages or cost is shown in the status bar.
config.claudeProvider.auto: Auto-detect: checks ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (settings.json/env), then credentials file, then AWS/API key environment variables.
config.claudeProvider.claudeAi: Claude.ai subscription — shows rate limit utilization (5h window, 7d window if available).
config.claudeProvider.zAi: z.ai (GLM models) — detected via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; no rate limits, shows token cost only (priced per GLM model).
config.claudeProvider.customEndpoint: Custom Anthropic-compatible endpoint (via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) — no rate limits, shows token cost only.
config.claudeProvider.awsBedrock: AWS Bedrock — no rate limits, shows token cost only.
config.claudeProvider.apiKey: Anthropic API key — no rate limits, shows token cost only.
config.pricing.inputPerMillion.desc: Fallback cost per 1M input tokens in USD when the model is unknown. Default: $3.00 (Claude Sonnet 4.x). Known models (Claude, GLM) are priced automatically.
config.pricing.outputPerMillion.desc: Fallback cost per 1M output tokens in USD when the model is unknown. Default: $15.00 (Claude Sonnet 4.x). Known models (Claude, GLM) are priced automatically.
config.pricing.cacheReadPerMillion.desc: Fallback cost per 1M cache-read tokens in USD when the model is unknown. Default: $0.30 (Claude Sonnet 4.x).
config.pricing.cacheCreatePerMillion.des: Fallback cost per 1M cache-creation tokens in USD when the model is unknown. Default: $3.75 (Claude Sonnet 4.x).
config.pricing.models.desc: Per-model price overrides keyed by model name or prefix (e.g. "glm-4.6", "claude-opus"). Each value is an object with inputPerMillion, outputPerMillion, cacheReadPerMillion, cacheCreatePerMillion. Overrides the built-in price table.
